name: IAXO
summary: A next-generation large solar-axion telescope combining a large magnetic volume, X-ray focusing and extremely low-background detectors.
detection_principle: Solar axions convert to X-rays inside a magnet; focusing optics concentrate them onto small-area detectors.

sites.name: Proposed international axion observatory; final site and full construction status unverified

key_parameters.name: Projected coupling reach
key_parameters.value: g_aγ approximately 10⁻¹² GeV⁻¹; g_ae approximately 10⁻¹³; both are design projections

results.summary: The physics study reports discovery potential; BabyIAXO construction does not establish completion of the full IAXO instrument.

science_scope: Primarily searches for solar-produced axions or hidden photons as complementary tests of dark-matter candidates. Solar flux is distinct from cold Galactic-halo dark matter; a solar-axion discovery alone would not establish the composition of cosmic dark matter.
